source_steps.summary: Place each tube of bead-bound captured cDNA input material on the high position of the magnetic rack.
boundary_notes: Until-clear endpoint is represented by nominal magnetic durations.

source_steps.summary: Incubate until the solution clears, about 2 minutes.
While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
boundary_notes: Under-specified resuspension uses the reviewed 80% volume x 10 convention.

source_steps.summary: While still on the magnetic rack, add 125 uL of Wash Buffer 3 to each tube. Do not discard the Wash Buffer 3 until directed, because it is used in another step.
boundary_notes: The default public artifact executes the immediate-continuation branch.

source_steps.summary: Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard Wash Buffer 3.
Remove the tube(s) from the magnetic rack.
Fully resuspend each bead pellet with 100 uL of the Template Switch Master Mix. Because the mix is viscous, full resuspension may take time.
Briefly centrifuge without letting beads collect at the bottom of the tube(s).
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Fully resuspend each bead pellet by mixing 5x with a P200 set to 75 uL.
Place the tube(s) into a thermocycler and run the Template Switch program.
Continue immediately to the cDNA amplification module, or proceed to the storage steps below before cDNA amplification.
For optional storage, place the tube(s) on the high position of the magnetic rack and incubate until the solution clears, about 2 minutes. Beads may need to be resuspended if settled.
While still on the magnetic rack, remove and discard the supernatant.
Remove the tube(s) from the magnetic rack.
Fully resuspend each bead pellet with 125 uL Wash Buffer 2.
Template-switched cDNA can be stored at 4C for up to 18 hours. Do not freeze.

semantic_boundaries.label: Brief centrifuge
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Brief non-fractionating centrifuge handling is not represented as a material separation.

semantic_boundaries.label: Magnet position
semantic_boundaries.paper_wording: Magnet rack position is execution-layer mapping; Culsma represents persistent rack context and timed magnetic separation.
